FollowUpEvent.description:
Emitted when the supervisor acts on a completed turn.

``reason`` and ``text`` are ``None``-optional and omitted from the wire
form via the global ``exclude_none=True`` in :func:`to_json_line`.

action.description: Supervisor action taken after the turn.
action.title: Action

at.description: Nanoseconds since the Unix epoch when the event was created.
at.title: At

reason.description: Reason for the action, if applicable.
reason.title: Reason

text.description: Follow-up text sent to the agent, if any.
text.title: Text

FollowUpEvent.title: FollowUpEvent

LaunchEvent.description:
Written by the supervisor as the log's first line: launch provenance.

``max_usd``, ``model``, and ``effort`` are ``None``-optional and omitted
from the wire form via the global ``exclude_none=True`` in
:func:`to_json_line`.

at.description: Nanoseconds since the Unix epoch when the event was created.
at.title: At

dirty.description: False when the worktree is clean, or dirty-file details.
dirty.title: Dirty

head_sha.description: Git HEAD commit SHA at launch time.
head_sha.title: Head Sha

kickoff_summary.description: One-line summary of the kickoff prompt.
kickoff_summary.title: Kickoff Summary

max_usd.description: Spend cap in US dollars, if configured.
max_usd.title: Max Usd

UsageUpdateEvent.description:
Emitted when the driver observes updated cumulative cost.

``settled`` marks a usage update carried by a result message that has
already settled the session on its own; a spend-cap observer must not
treat it as a live crossing of the cap, since the session is ending
regardless. Always written to the wire (``"settled": false`` on an
unsettled update).

at.description: Nanoseconds since the Unix epoch when the event was created.
at.title: At

cost_usd.description: Cumulative session cost in US dollars.
cost_usd.title: Cost Usd

settled.description: Whether the session has already settled.
settled.title: Settled

UsageUpdateEvent.title: UsageUpdateEvent
